brand.name: AETHRA
brand.tagline_primary: From the unseen to the extraordinary.
brand.concept: The Architecture of the Unseen — Phase-Shift from Negative Space (Abstraction) to Geometric Precision (Engineered Structure)

aethra_cobalt.role: Primary brand signature, key structural panels, active interactive states, architectural focal blocks

signal_vermilion.role: Architectural datum lines, phase-shift markers, primary call-to-action triggers, critical highlights

warm_alabaster.role: Primary light background surface, editorial canvas, negative-space counterforms, dark-mode primary typography

graphite_slate.role: Secondary body copy, captions, technical metadata, muted UI labels on light surfaces

obsidian_surface.role: Elevated modular cards, code blocks, and structural containers on Carbon Ink dark surfaces

slate_hairline_dark.role: 1px structural grid lines and dividers on Carbon Ink dark surfaces
